s2_catalogue_items.note: Sentinel-2 L2A catalogue items touching the AOI, before removing repeated tile-overpass items

s2_items_sharing_tile_overpass.note: catalogue items whose MGRS tile and overpass minute match another item (mostly reprocessed copies)

s2_scenes.note: Sentinel-2 L2A items touching the AOI, one per tile and overpass (tiles counted separately)

s2_scene_usable_share.note: scenes with >= 80% of AOI pixels clear (SCL not in [0, 1, 3, 8, 9, 10])

share_weeks_usable.note: weeks with at least one Sentinel-2 acquisition >= 80% clear over the AOI

weeks_blind.note: no usable optical look (cloudy or no acquisition)

weeks_no_s2_acquisition.note: no Sentinel-2 acquisition at all (cadence gap)

longest_blind_run_2019.note: within ISO year 2019 (runs cut at year boundary)

s2_looks_2019.note: Sentinel-2 scenes read in ISO year 2019; drops when only one satellite flew

longest_blind_run_2020.note: within ISO year 2020 (runs cut at year boundary)

s2_looks_2020.note: Sentinel-2 scenes read in ISO year 2020; drops when only one satellite flew

longest_blind_run_2021.note: within ISO year 2021 (runs cut at year boundary)

s2_looks_2021.note: Sentinel-2 scenes read in ISO year 2021; drops when only one satellite flew

longest_blind_run_2022.note: within ISO year 2022 (runs cut at year boundary)

s2_looks_2022.note: Sentinel-2 scenes read in ISO year 2022; drops when only one satellite flew

longest_blind_run_2023.note: within ISO year 2023 (runs cut at year boundary)

s2_looks_2023.note: Sentinel-2 scenes read in ISO year 2023; drops when only one satellite flew

longest_blind_run_2024.note: within ISO year 2024 (runs cut at year boundary)

s2_looks_2024.note: Sentinel-2 scenes read in ISO year 2024; drops when only one satellite flew

longest_blind_run_2025.note: within ISO year 2025 (runs cut at year boundary)

s2_looks_2025.note: Sentinel-2 scenes read in ISO year 2025; drops when only one satellite flew

share_weeks_usable_jan.note: weeks whose Thursday falls in month 1, all years (31 weeks)

share_weeks_usable_feb.note: weeks whose Thursday falls in month 2, all years (29 weeks)

share_weeks_usable_mar.note: weeks whose Thursday falls in month 3, all years (30 weeks)

share_weeks_usable_apr.note: weeks whose Thursday falls in month 4, all years (30 weeks)

share_weeks_usable_may.note: weeks whose Thursday falls in month 5, all years (31 weeks)

share_weeks_usable_jun.note: weeks whose Thursday falls in month 6, all years (30 weeks)

share_weeks_usable_jul.note: weeks whose Thursday falls in month 7, all years (31 weeks)

share_weeks_usable_aug.note: weeks whose Thursday falls in month 8, all years (31 weeks)

share_weeks_usable_sep.note: weeks whose Thursday falls in month 9, all years (30 weeks)

share_weeks_usable_oct.note: weeks whose Thursday falls in month 10, all years (32 weeks)

share_weeks_usable_nov.note: weeks whose Thursday falls in month 11, all years (29 weeks)

share_weeks_usable_dec.note: weeks whose Thursday falls in month 12, all years (31 weeks)

s1_acq_per_week_mean.note: distinct Sentinel-1 IW GRD passes (unique platform+absolute orbit) touching the AOI; counts only

s1_share_weeks_with_acq.note: weeks with >= 1 Sentinel-1 IW acquisition; radar is cloud-independent

share_weeks_usable_tile_rule.note: secondary: weeks with a scene whose tile-level eo:cloud_cover <= 20%

agreement_aoi_vs_tile_rule.note: weeks where the AOI-level and tile-level rules agree
